definitions.explanation: The raising of pigs as livestock, and by extension the industry built around it.

examples.japanese: {養豚|ようとん}を{営|いとな}む。
この{地域|ちいき}は{養豚|ようとん}が{盛|さか}んだ。
examples.english: Pig farming is thriving in this region.

examples.japanese: {祖父|そふ}は{長年|ながねん}{養豚|ようとん}{業|ぎょう}を{続|つづ}けてきた。
examples.english: My grandfather has run a pig-farming business for many years.

notes:
The raising of pigs as livestock, and the industry built around it. Usually appears in compounds naming the place, business, or worker.

COMPOUNDS:
- {養豚|ようとん}{場|じょう}: pig farm
- {養豚|ようとん}{業|ぎょう}: the pig-farming industry
- {養豚|ようとん}{農家|のうか}: pig farmer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {養鶏|ようけい}: poultry farming — raising chickens
- {畜産|ちくさん}: livestock farming — the broader field, covering all farm animals
